name: Guowang (China SatNet) broadband satellite
note: Parity model for the v1.1 'Guowang Sat' type. Body frame: +Z nadir, +X velocity. A 3 x 1 x 1 m box with two arrays spanning 10 m, tracking the Sun about the cross-track axis; no brightness mitigation (none reported). Everything beyond the box size and span is an estimate. Benchmark: mallama2025_constellations Guowang row (4.21 at 1000 km, orbit-raising near 1053 km).
